obligations.name: Overlap equality
obligations.evidence: Actual typed resolvent defect identity plus delta=0 derives C Rf=Rc C wherever both resolvents exist. This is proved, not supplied.

obligations.name: Analytic gluing
obligations.evidence: Both resolvent sets open. On fine resolvent neighborhood glued function equals left holomorphic resolvent expression; on coarse neighborhood right expression follows from overlap equality. This proves holomorphy on union, including boundary points of either individual set.

obligations.name: Domain and traces
obligations.evidence: Common h is holomorphic on union of independently supplied domains. Each cycle trace belongs to own domain and own resolvent set, hence comparison V. No trace-in-other-resolvent assumption.

obligations.name: Exterior winding
obligations.evidence: Outside V, if a point belongs to either resolvent set it lies outside both domains and both windings0; otherwise it lies in both actual spectra and both windings1. No inclusion/equality of spectra assumed.

obligations.evidence: On fine trace glue=C Rf; on coarse trace glue=Rc C. Actual bounded-map integral commutation, using explicitly established trace-continuity, converts equal cycle integrals to C-times-fine and coarse-times-C integrals.
